name: Huttons Asia
summary: Large agency presence for rentals and purchases across Singapore districts — verify CEA registration, commission, and renewal terms before viewings.
body: Use agency scale for inventory breadth, then judge the agent on response time and contract hygiene. Never skip reading the tenancy agreement because someone is 'in a hurry.' On tenant representation, insist on a CEA prescribed Estate Agency Agreement that states commission, GST, and whether renewal attracts a further fee — there is no statutory rate, and surprise year-two invoices are a recurring expat complaint. On the buy side, treat ABSD and BSD timelines as critical path — foreigners often underestimate cash due within days of the OTP. Ask whether the agent has closed FTA-remission purchases before if you are US or EFTA-national; process mistakes are expensive at 60% ABSD. Pay the agency with a receipt; dual commission from both sides of one deal is an offence.
